title: Funky Foodstuffs
description: Tired of boring, generic foods? Wish you could breathe fire from spiciness, fly using gas from beans, or blind an enemy with tomato splatter? This mod has it all (and more)!
body:
## Important Stuff

<details>
<summary>-Overview-</summary>

_To give you a rough idea of what is included without making you read about every single feature._

* **Peppers**, let you breathe fire!
* Throwable **Tomatos** that blind players!
* **Purpabeans** let you fly by farting!
* **Chocolate Doubloons**, which increase the strength of your status effects!
* New effects like **Phasing** which lets you walk through certain blocks!
* An awesome **Popsicle** that can block up to 90% of damage (for one attack)!
</details>
<details>
<summary>-My Other Projects-</summary>

_These mods may not all be updated to the latest version. All of these mods are owned and maintained by me._

[**Rainbows & Radium**](https://modrinth.com/mod/rainbows-and-radium) - Powerful new ores can be used to make customizable bombs, 128-slot barrels, a modular chest-locking system, Ender Pearls enchanted with infinity, Paxels, multi-use Totems, and more!

[**Savage Cyclopes**](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-cyclopes-mod) - New Cyclops entities can be found across all 3 dimensions. Some are hostile, attacking you with poisonous darts or magic, while others are neutral or passive, bartering with or assisting you in your various adventures.  Enticing rewards are granted to those who can defeat them.

[**Beastly Buggers**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beastly-buggers) -  Unique and useful items can be obtained by facing new and difficult insects and arachnids, each with a unique spawn location to incentivize exploration. Increasing the challenge of Minecraft in fun and vanilla-friendly ways is the purpose of this mod.

[**Funky Foodstuffs**](https://modrinth.com/mod/funky-foodstuffs) - Adds a few silly new items, all of which have their own functionality, including spicy peppers that make you breathe fire, beans that let you fly via flatulence, and so much more!
</details>

## Content & Features

_In-depth explanation of every feature._

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/jj9tQqMvTfk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<details>
<summary>Items</summary>
<details>
<summary>Baguette</summary>

The **Baguette** is a new melee weapon.  It can be crafted from 3 bread vertically aligned in a Crafting Table. It has 7 attack damage, 0.9 attack speed, and 2 extra blocks of reach. It can also be eaten (at the cost of 1/3 of its max durability).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Cheese</summary>

Smelting a Bucket of Milk will turn it into a **Bucket of Cheese**, which can be placed and will spread like a cross between a solid and a liquid.  While standing on a **Cheese Layer**, you are incapable of jumping. You can craft a Bucket of Cheese into 9 **Cheese Sticks**, which remove a random status effect.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Chocolate Doubloons</summary>
  
Shipwrecks are guarenteed to have at least one chocolate doubloon in their Map chests (if they have one), with a chance for up to five. When consumed, it will either apply its corresponding effect (if the effect is not already applied) or add 1 to the amplifier of the effect and divide its duration by 2. **Copper Chocolate Doubloons** modify Haste, **Golden Chocolate Doubloons** modify Absorption, and **Iron Chocolate Doubloons** modify Jump Boost. Each doubloon can also be crafted with Sugar, Cocoa Beans, and the matching nugget (Copper Nuggets, for example.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Coconuts</summary>

In Jungle Temples, a new block called the **Coconut** can generate in a chest. It has the same shape as a Skeleton Skull. Mineable with any tool, they drop two **Coconut Halves** (unless mined with Silk Touch) which can be eaten and grant the same hunger and saturation as Mushroom Stew. If you throw a Coconut at an entity, it will replace their helmet with a Coconut Half and drop the helmet and another Coconut Half.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mystery Meat</summary>

Every Shipwreck with a Supply chest will generate 1-4 **Raw Mystery Meat** and 0-2 **Cooked Mystery Meat**. Raw Mystery Meat will apply either Hunger, Nausea, and Poison, or Saturation. Raw Mystery Meat has a 75% chance to apply the negative effects and a 25% chance to apply the positive effect. Smelting it will cook it, and its cooked variant has a 75% chance to apply the positive effect and a 25% chance to apply the negative one.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Peppers</summary>

Jungle Temples now have a use; every chest inside of them now has a 100% chance to spawn 1-4 **Jungle Peppers**. These foods apply the **Spiciness** effect at level 1 for 20 seconds. This effect will ignite all blocks you walk on. If you smelt it instead, you can make a **Dried Pepper**.  This is basically the same except that it applies the effect at level 2, letting you breathe fire out of your mouth for its duration.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Purpabeans</summary>

**Purpabeans** are a new item that can be found in End City chests. They are consumed twice as fast as most other foods, and have a 50% chance to apply the new status effect **Flatulence** for 10 seconds. While this effect is applied, you will release gas that will propel yourself forward.  You can craft the beans into a **Bucket of Purpabeans** for a 100% chance to recieve the effect for 60 seconds, or compress them to (or decompress them from) a **Block of Purpabeans**
</details>

<details>
<summary>Tomatos</summary>

**Tomatos** have a 15% chance to spawn in Jungle Temple chests, a 5% chance to spawn in Plains and Savannah Village chests, and can be brushed from suspicious sand in Trail Ruins. They cannot be eaten, but when they are thrown at an entity that entity is slowed and (if it's a player) has red splatter overlay applied. This effect is called **Splatter**. You can plant them similarly to sugarcane, but they are a 2-block tall plant and they have 4 stages. You cannot bonemeal them.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Intangiberries</summary>

**Intangiberries**, found in End Cities, apply a new effect called **Phasing**. This effect causes you to ignore block collisions with the following blocks:
<details>
<summary>Blocks</summary>
  
- Doors
- Trapdoors
- Glass
- Glass Panes
- Leaves
- Bars
- Fences

</details>
</details>

All other items are pretty simple and won't be explained here.
</details>

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
<details>
<summary>How may I use this mod in my own content?</summary>

_"Credit" refers to either a link to my Modrinth profile or to this Modrinth page._

**Servers** - When using this mod on a server, credit is appreciated but NOT required.

**Videos** - When using this mod in a video, if the mod is prominently featured (like in a showcase) credit IS required.  Otherwise (for example, if the video is an SMP and the mod just comes with it), credit is appreciated but NOT required.

**Modpacks** - When adding this mod to a modpack, credit IS required on the page of the modpack.  When playing a modpack with this mod, credit is appreciated but NOT required.
</details>

<details>
<summary>How can I help?</summary>

I am currently just doing this as a hobby, so you cannot donate to me.  However, if you find any issues or bugs, **reporting the issues on the issue tracker** would be extremely helpful.  Also, to let me know that people are enjoying the mods I make, **liking/following** the mod would be greatly appreciated.
</details>
<details>
<summary>May I make a port of this mod?</summary>

No, you **MAY NOT** port this mod to a different modloader, a different Minecraft version, or a different platform.  I worked very hard to concept, program, and publish this mod, and while I understand that the loader/version/platform of this mod might not suit everybody's wishes, I do not want anyone to make a port of this mod.

Currently, I try to keep all of my (unarchived) mods up-to-date with the latest version of Minecraft.  Please be patient if the mod is not updated as soon as you like.  I am probably working on it when I have time.
</details>
<details>
<summary>What Minecraft versions do you plan on updating/backporting this mod to?</summary>

I try to update the mod to the latest Minecraft version as soon as possible. When the mod itself gets updates like new features or content, only the latest version of Minecraft will receive that content. I do not plan on backporting this mod.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Where do you recommend I start learning how to mod?</summary>

I mostly taught myself, but I definitely used resources like [**Datapack Generators**](https://misode.github.io) which is a useful tool for legibly creating .json files. Also, [**Modding by Kaupenjoe**](https://youtube.com/@ModdingByKaupenjoe) is a YouTube channel with EXTREMELY helpful tutorials about most aspects of modding Minecraft.
</details>
<details>
<summary>How do I install this mod?</summary>

First, download the [**Fabric Installer**](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) and the [**Fabric API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). Put the Fabric API into your “mods” folder along with this one. Then, open the Minecraft Launcher and launch the game. (MAKE SURE that the Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and this mod are all the same version!)
</details>
